_NOTE: DEMONSTRATION TENANT — not a real customer. Exists to show that the pipeline is company-agnostic: the same scraped corpus, scored against a completely different profile, produces a completely different shortlist. Every figure here is invented.
description: Demonstration tenant — a civil engineering and building contractor
summary: Padma Infrastructure Limited delivers civil engineering and building construction for government and development-sector clients across Bangladesh. Core strengths are road and bridge works, water infrastructure, multi-storey building construction, and the long-term maintenance contracts that follow them.
services: Road construction, widening and bituminous carpeting works
Multi-storey building construction with reinforced concrete foundations
Vertical extension and structural strengthening of existing buildings
Deep tube well installation and submersible pump commissioning
Water supply networks, overhead tanks and distribution pipelines
River dredging, embankment protection and re-excavation works
Site preparation, earthworks and land development
Electrical installation, substation and distribution line works
Building services — plumbing, sanitary and HVAC installation
Routine and periodic maintenance of roads and drainage
Repair, renovation and thorough repair of government quarters and offices
Precast concrete production and supply for infrastructure projects
Flood protection and coastal embankment works
exclusions: Software development, information technology services and systems integration
Supply of computers, servers, networking equipment and office IT hardware
Management consultancy, feasibility studies and institutional capacity building
Supply of manpower, security guards, cleaners and office support personnel
Medical equipment, laboratory devices and pharmaceutical supply
Food, agricultural commodities and consumable goods supply
Printing, publication, advertising and media production

pastProjects.title: Rural road improvement by bituminous carpeting
pastProjects.description: Widening and bituminous carpeting of 42 km of rural roads including culvert reconstruction, shoulder work and drainage across three upazilas.

pastProjects.title: Deep tube well installation programme
pastProjects.description: Installation of 220 deep tube wells with submersible pumps, platform construction and commissioning across two districts.

pastProjects.title: Six-storey academic building construction
pastProjects.description: Construction of a six-storey academic building with six-storey foundation, including electrical and plumbing installation and external development.

pastProjects.title: River re-excavation and embankment protection
pastProjects.description: Re-excavation of 18 km of river channel by cutter suction dredger with disposal, plus embankment slope protection.

pastProjects.title: Government quarters thorough repair programme
pastProjects.description: Thorough repair and renovation of multi-unit government residential quarters including structural repair, re-roofing and services replacement.

pastProjects.title: Rural electrification distribution works
pastProjects.description: Construction of distribution lines, substation civil works and installation of transformers across rural feeder networks.
